title: 2023 AMC 12A Problem 1
statement: Cities \(A\) and \(B\) are \(45\) miles apart. Alicia lives in \(A\) and Beth lives in \(B.\) Alicia bikes towards \(B\) at \(18\) miles per hour. Leaving at the same time, Beth bikes toward \(A\) at \(12\) miles per hour. How many miles from City \(A\) will they be when they meet?

solutions.text:
The gap between them closes at \(18+12=30\) miles per hour, so they meet after \(\dfrac{45}{30}=1.5\) hours.

In that time Alicia has ridden \(18\cdot 1.5=27\) miles from City \(A.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: Their closing speed is \(18+12\) miles per hour
Find the time until they meet, then multiply by Alicia’s speed
